```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(opalr)
options(nfilter.tab = 3)

dat <- qof_asthma_cohort_dist_gs_sf |> 
  dplyr::select("lsoa11cd", "has_asthma","uprn","distance_local_greenspace", "sex") |> 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() 

# Uploading a subset to save upload time

#dat <- dat |> dplyr::filter(lsoa11cd %in% sample(levels(factor(dat$lsoa11cd)), 35))
dat$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(dat)) # needs a unique row id

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
opal.table_save(
```

```{r}
library(DSOpal)
library(dsBase)
library(dsBaseClient)


builder <- DSI::newDSLoginBuilder()

builder$append(server = "study1", 
               url = "http://localhost:8880", 
               user = "administrator", 
               password = "password", 
               table = "UPRN.greenspace_distance_metrics", 
               profile = "ds-geospatial")

builder$append(server = "study2", 
               url = "http://localhost:8880", 
               user = "administrator", 
               password = "password", 
               table = "UPRN.greenspace_distance_metrics", 
               profile = "ds-geospatial")

logindata <- builder$build()

conns <- DSI::datashield.login(logins = logindata, assign = TRUE, symbol = "D")


ds.colnames("D", conns)

```


```{r}
library(dsGeospatialClient)
names_region <- list(c("Liverpool", "Sefton"), c("Liverpool"))

ds.summarystat(x = "D$has_asthma", y = "D$lsoa11cd", 
               type='combe', do.checks=FALSE, 
               draw.plot = TRUE, names_region = names_region, 
               metric = "Mean", datasources=conns)
```


```{r}

ds.groupcor(x = "D$has_asthma", y = "D$distance_local_greenspace", 
            index = "D$lsoa11cd", datasources = conns, type = "split", 
            names_region = names_region)
```

```{r}
ds.chisqr(rvar="D$sex", cvar="D$has_asthma", stvar="D$lsoa11cd", 
          exclude=NULL,	useNA ="no", suppress.chisq.warnings=FALSE,
          datasources=NULL, names_region = "Liverpool",
          force.nfilter=NULL, split = FALSE, draw.plot = TRUE)
```


```{r}
ds.geoheatmapPlot(x="D$has_asthma", y = "D$lsoa11cd", datasources = conns)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
fitdat <- ds.glmerSLMA(formula="D$has_asthma ~ D$sex + (1|D$lsoa11cd)",
             family="poisson",datasources=conns
)
```
Add a new chunk by clicking the *Insert Chunk* button on the toolbar or by pressing *Cmd+Option+I*.

When you save the notebook, an HTML file containing the code and output will be saved alongside it (click the *Preview* button or press *Cmd+Shift+K* to preview the HTML file). 

The preview shows you a rendered HTML copy of the contents of the editor. Consequently, unlike *Knit*, *Preview* does not run any R code chunks. Instead, the output of the chunk when it was last run in the editor is displayed.
